segment_contamination_dimensions: Wooden/log/bamboo frame house buyers (siblings: Wooden House, Log Homes, Log Cabin, Prefabricated Wooden House, Bamboo Huts) — buyers seeking natural or timber-frame construction are incompatible with steel-frame buyers; discard any name containing wood, wooden, timber, log, bamboo, or natural material references

Container-converted dwelling buyers (sibling: Container Homes) — buyers seeking ISO shipping container conversions are a distinct sub-segment with different structural and regulatory expectations; discard any name leading with 'container home' or 'container house' as primary descriptor

Guard hut / security cabin micro-structure buyers (siblings: Guard Huts, PVC Guard Huts) — buyers seeking small single-purpose security enclosures are incompatible with residential/accommodation house buyers; discard any name that primarily targets guard room or security kiosk use

Prefab bunkhouse-only buyers (siblings: Bunkhouses, Prefab Steel Bunk House, MS Bunkhouse, Bunk House Office) — bunkhouse is a specific dormitory-style labour accommodation sub-type carved out as its own sibling; discard any name using 'bunkhouse' or 'bunk house' as the primary descriptor
